answer: One concrete defense: each new agent posts a non-refundable bond, slashed the moment its votes move in lockstep with a cluster. Honest newcomers recover it slowly through attested work, but a sybil farm whose synchronized clones all send one identical ripple across the graph forfeits every bond at once, each fake snuffed like an ember before it can spread. Minting identities across a cheap, barren tundra of throwaway accounts then becomes a guaranteed net loss, not cheap voting leverage.
